name: 代码 / API 记忆
description: 示例插件：记忆函数签名、参数、返回值与易错点。演示 number / checkbox 字段和 {{^}} 反向区块。

templates.front:
{{lang}}{{api}}
{{#signature}}
{{signature}}
{{/signature}}{{^signature}}
回忆它的参数与返回值
{{/signature}}
templates.back:
{{lang}}{{api}}
{{#signature}}
{{signature}}
{{/signature}}{{#returns}}
↩︎ 返回：{{returns}}
{{/returns}}
{{#mutates}}⚠️ 修改原对象{{/mutates}}{{#since}}修订版 {{since}}{{/since}}
{{#example}}
{{example}}
{{/example}}{{#pitfall}}
💥 {{pitfall}}
{{/pitfall}}

ai.prompt:
把下面的材料拆成 {{count}} 张编程知识闪卡。
每张卡字段：
- api：函数、方法或 API 的完整名字
- lang：语言，只能取 JavaScript/TypeScript/Python/Java/Kotlin/Go/Rust/SQL/Bash/其他
- signature：调用签名，写清参数名与可选性；如果没有参数就填空字符串
- returns：返回值说明，可空
- example：一段能跑的最小示例代码
- pitfall：常见坑，可留空
- since：该特性引入的主版本号（数字，如 2015）；不确定就填空字符串并让 mutates 为 false
- mutates：是否会修改原对象，true 或 false
只输出 JSON，格式：{"cards":[{"api":"...","lang":"JavaScript","signature":"...","returns":"...","example":"...","pitfall":"...","since":2015,"mutates":false}]}

材料：
{{text}}

en.name: Code / API memory
en.description: Example plugin: memorise function signatures, parameters, return values and pitfalls. Demonstrates number / checkbox fields and the {{^}} inverted section.

ai.prompt:
Split the material below into {{count}} programming flashcards.
Fields per card:
- api: the full name of the function, method or API
- lang: the language, one of JavaScript/TypeScript/Python/Java/Kotlin/Go/Rust/SQL/Bash/Other
- signature: the call signature, with parameter names and optionality made clear; use an empty string if it takes no parameters
- returns: what it returns, may be empty
- example: a minimal piece of example code that runs
- pitfall: common traps, may be empty
- since: the major version that introduced it (a number, e.g. 2015); if you are unsure use an empty string and set mutates to false
- mutates: whether it modifies the original object, true or false
Output JSON only, in the form: {"cards":[{"api":"...","lang":"JavaScript","signature":"...","returns":"...","example":"...","pitfall":"...","since":2015,"mutates":false}]}

Material:
{{text}}
